title: How to Use NVIDIA Warp and MjWarp to Accelerate Robotics Simulation and Learning Workflows
summary: This guide explains how to use NVIDIA Warp, a GPU-accelerated simulation framework, alongside MjWarp, its MuJoCo-based physics backend, to speed up robotics simulation and reinforcement learning workflows. It covers setup, differentiable simulation, batched environments, and integration with ML pipelines for faster training and policy learning.
